description.narrative: The TEENS project employs iterative design approaches and new technologies in the support to safe spaces for vulnerable young women and adolescent girls. The programme strategy seeks to accelerate and scale up the new technologies that have been provided in the safe spaces of engagement for women and adolescent girls that for the first time in Malawi employed digitalisation as a network and information platforms for empowerment of girls and young women in the safe spaces. The unique aspects of this Ireland funded work is the introduction of IT to enhance the model. It employs sophisticated iterative programming responding to context and individuals (mentees) with the overall aim to contribute to transformation of targeted young women and girls. Safe Spaces as a methodology is a gender transformative approach that has proven to work to protect and empower young girls and engage men in Malawi and elsewhere.
